results.label: Free trial (days)
results.description: How long a new dairy owner uses the app free. 0 turns the trial off.

results.label: Collection fee
results.description: The platform fee taken from a dairy's wallet for each collection recorded, after the free trial.

results.label: Recharge bonus
results.description: Extra credit added to a recharge; the highest tier an amount qualifies for applies.

results.label: Low-balance prompt (₹)
results.description: Under this the app asks the dairy to recharge.

results.label: Low-balance notification (₹)
results.description: A dairy whose wallet drops below this is sent a warning.

results.label: Referrals
results.description: What a referral pays and how often a code can be used.

fields.name: MAX_REFERRAL_USES
fields.label: Most times one code can be used

results.label: Oldest app version allowed
results.description: An app older than this is forced to update. Empty means no one is forced. Check the version split on Growth first.

results.label: Role-card layout
results.description: How the post-login screen decides which role card is big. Change only if you know why.

fields.name: WINDOW_DAYS
fields.label: Days of history read
fields.help: The longest period the ranking looks back.

fields.name: MID_DAYS
fields.label: Middle period (days)
fields.help: Between the recent and the full window.

fields.name: RECENT_DAYS
fields.label: Recent period (days)
fields.help: At least 1; the most recent visits weigh the most.

fields.name: MIN_SCORE
fields.label: Minimum score to rank
fields.help: At least 1: below it everyone sees the default layout.

fields.name: DEDUPE_SECONDS
fields.label: Double-tap window (seconds)
fields.help: A repeat inside it is not a second visit.

fields.name: RETENTION_DAYS
fields.label: Days of usage kept
fields.help: Must not be below the history read.
